summary: First full test of Audience Radar (demo mode). Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (config, audiences sample + AI refine, run cost 2.5/0, validation 422, kit-before-pay 402, 404, mock pay launch results X High/Telegram Medium/Reddit Low/YouTube Medium with sample sizes 500/40/300/120 and 8 keywords, AI launch kit, creator_ranking, history mine/all). Frontend: desktop launch flow end-to-end OK (sample -> Day traders/Long-term holders/NFT collectors, refine gives 3 new AI cards, $2.50 -> $0.00 when X unchecked -> $2.50, 'Pay $2.50 with crypto', mock dialog + confirmation + tx hash, results rows + Estimate + 8 keyword chips + Demo data badge, kit with highlights, card image, copy/download buttons, zip download audience-radar-launch-kit.zip). Mobile 390px creator flow OK (role selector, mock pay with ETH, creator-ranking-list with label/reason/best format/Estimate, no horizontal overflow). Mobile menu, history tabs + row links, /roadmap 3 columns, landing sections (how, modes, features, pricing, roadmap, faq), theme toggle + logo swap all OK. Found and FIXED one real bug: brand accent colour was broken app-wide (interest bars rendered black, invisible in dark mode).

minor.issue: Not concurrency-safe: two simultaneous calls on a pending run both compute results and write different tx_hash/keywords (no atomic status check e.g. find_one_and_update with status=pending_payment).
Same race: React StrictMode/double clicks can fire two concurrent kit generations; the one shown may differ from the one persisted. Use an atomic set-if-absent.
Exposes every user's niche descriptions to anyone (by design for demo, but note privacy).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: custom --accent (#E5482D / #FF6A4A) was overwritten later in the same :root/.dark block by the shadcn HSL token '--accent: 40 33% 89%'. So var(--accent) was invalid -> interest bars filled black (rgb(0,0,0)) in both themes (near-invisible in dark), text-brand/bg-brand (cost total, rank numbers, hero accent words, roadmap bullet dots, confirm check icon), keyword highlight underline and ::selection all lost the accent colour. Renamed custom token to --brand-accent (index.css, tailwind.config.js brand, Interest.jsx). Verified fill now rgb(229,72,45) light / rgb(255,106,74) dark.
navigator.clipboard.writeText has no try/catch; when clipboard is denied (e.g. non-secure/iframe/headless) nothing happens and no error toast is shown (unhandled rejection).

design_issues.screen: Header logo (mobile, when content scrolls under sticky header / dialog overlay)
issues: Logo PNGs appear to have an opaque background slightly different from the header bg, showing a visible rectangle behind 'Audience Radar' wordmark when scrolled. Use transparent PNG/SVG.
AI sometimes returns the same platform twice (e.g. YouTube x2, Telegram x2) - acceptable as communities, but consider limiting per platform or grouping.

action_items: Review my CSS fix (--accent renamed to --brand-accent) and keep it; do not reintroduce a custom var with a shadcn token name
Make pay and kit endpoints idempotent under concurrency (atomic find_one_and_update on status / kit null)
Wrap clipboard copy in try/catch with an error toast
Use transparent logo assets so no box shows on the sticky header
critical_code_review_comments: server.py pay_run: check-then-write race (status read, slow AI call, then update) - use conditional update
Kit.jsx useEffect has no cancellation; in StrictMode dev it calls /kit twice
No delete endpoint for runs; tests clean up via direct Mongo by id

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; accent colour bug fixed by tester)

seed_data_creation: Created runs during tests; all my runs deleted by id. Note: during dark-mode check I opened the kit page for an existing paid creator run (client 0f6e2816..., not created by me) which generated and saved a kit on that run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_audience_radar.py -n 0 (pytest.ini forces xdist; use -n 0 not -p no:xdist). Pay/kit AI calls take ~5-20s. History 'mine' depends on localStorage ar_client_id. Sample description round 0 returns fixed audiences; refine uses Gemini.
rca of the issue: Accent colour bug: index.css :root defines --accent twice (custom hex on line 13, shadcn HSL triplet on line 30); the later wins, making var(--accent) = '40 33% 89%' which is invalid for fill/color, so SVG fill fell back to black. Mitigation applied: renamed custom token to --brand-accent.
